verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a GPU cloud platform with a CLI, SDK, and web console, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out in the CLI, SDK, console, or account settings. Scoped API keys, SSH key-only auth, and community privacy concerns about untrusted hosts are adjacent topics and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
